sloka: निहतानि शरैः दीप्तैः मानुषेण पदातिना ।खरः च निहतः संख्ये दूषणः च निपातितः ॥३-३६-९॥
transliteration: nihatāni śaraiḥ dīptaiḥ mānuṣeṇa padātinā ।kharaḥ ca nihataḥ saṁkhye dūṣaṇaḥ ca nipātitaḥ ॥3-36-9॥

translations.english: Khara, Dusana and Trisira were killed in war.The residents of Dandaka forest are rendered safe and fearless.
